title: Alonzo McDonald in Vallee's journals

tellings.quote: So, if you read Vallee's journals, uh he points out Alonzo McDonald as being uniquely involved in this.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to the published private journals of Jacques Vallee, a scientist who has studied UFOs for decades. Simosa says that in the late 1970s, under President Jimmy Carter, Vallee singled out Alonzo McDonald, a White House official, as uniquely involved in the UFO question. If true, it would put UFO interest inside the Carter White House itself.
